description: This file defines an interface class IControlService for controlling and managing control sessions within the Rialto media server component. It declares virtual methods for adding, removing, acknowledging controls, setting application state, and pinging clients.

classes.name: IControlService
classes.description: An interface class for control service operations within the Rialto media server.

methods.name: addControl
methods.description: Adds a control session identified by controlId with the specified client.

methods.name: removeControl
methods.description: Removes the control session identified by controlId.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Acknowledges a control message with the given controlId and message id.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Checks the connectivity with a client by sending a ping with the specified id and ackSender.
